audit_scope: Read-only source inspection. No cloud calls, live data reads, tests, credential access or deployment verification.
deployment_caveat: README.md:22 records release d8f9c21 / seattle-food-broker-00013-fum, while docs/TEAM-STACK.md:3 refers to dbf99118 and PR #19. These are historical documentation snapshots. Current local HEAD fcb4f76 was not established as the serving production commit.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Reviewed offer → grounded retrieval → feasibility checks → coordinator handoff
claims.verified_fact: FastAPI calls the ADK broker, whose bound Python tool retrieves through MCP, evaluates candidates, enriches context, obtains a bounded model plan, rechecks the fixed clock and renders a proposal.
claims.caveat: The pipeline returns proposals or an honest blocked/no-match/draft result, not confirmed operations.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Free-text alert → quoted fields → coordinator review
claims.verified_fact: Gemini 2.5 Flash on Vertex through ADK extracts explicitly declared storage, pallet count, product terms and hour durations. Clock times remain quoted for coordinator review; crates/loaves are not converted to pallets.
claims.caveat: Never turn expiry or FoodKeeper guidance into a donor pickup deadline.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Cloud Run us-east1 · FastAPI 8080 · private Toolbox 5000
claims.verified_fact: Service seattle-food-broker targets project qwiklabs-gcp-04-b992b9561e32 in us-east1. One container supervises official Toolbox and Uvicorn; Toolbox binds 127.0.0.1:5000 and API binds 0.0.0.0:8080 by default. Google ADK, the broker, deterministic matcher, context/evidence services and Google GenAI SDK are Python application dependencies/code running inside the Cloud Run container, in the API process. Vertex model inference and BigQuery are external managed services.
claims.caveat: These are code/configuration facts, not a fresh verification of the currently serving deployment.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Assigned Google Cloud project · runtime service identity
claims.verified_fact: Application identity uses ADC and the existing Cloud Run service account. Local deployment helper requires the lab student account class and the assigned project; CI uses a dedicated deployment service account.
claims.caveat: This audit did not inspect credentials, authenticate, call cloud APIs or verify image-generation model access.

claims.verified_fact: POST /api/match/stream returns application/x-ndjson. Its request-scoped stream contains sanitized stages and bounded counts, heartbeat/result/error records, with cancellation on disconnect.
claims.caveat: Do not label this SSE, a durable job, or a persistent event bus.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Local ADK broker ↔ Vertex AI Gemini 2.5 Flash
claims.verified_fact: Default inference model is gemini-2.5-flash in us-east1, accessed through a Vertex client configured with project/location. ADK Agent and Runner execute as Python library code in the Cloud Run API process. ADK exposes a request-bound broker_match function, not model-controlled arbitrary SQL or recipient selection. Only Gemini inference belongs in the external Vertex AI service box; do not place ADK in that external box.
claims.caveat: Environment can override GEMINI_MODEL and GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION; the snapshot default is what is verified here.

claims.verified_fact: The container copies the official Toolbox 1.14.0 binary. Broker, exact recipient evidence and context toolsets use MCP_v20250326.
claims.caveat: Team-operated official Toolbox; do not portray this as a separately hosted Google-managed BigQuery MCP service.

claims.verified_fact: Configured tools are vector_search_recipients, get_recipient_evidence, get_tract_equity and lookup_shelf_life.
claims.caveat: check_foodkeeper is not a current MCP tool name.

claims.verified_fact: The BigQuery source is restricted to a4i_food, location US, readOnly true, writeMode blocked, maximum 20 result rows and maximumBytesBilled 100000000.
claims.caveat: The retrieval-specific query returns at most 12 candidates.

claims.verified_fact: vector_search_recipients queries a4i_food.recipient_embeddings with AI.EMBED using gemini-embedding-2; top_k 12, COSINE, use_brute_force true. README documents 3072-dimensional vectors.
claims.caveat: Semantic candidates have not yet passed operational gates.

claims.verified_fact: get_recipient_evidence queries one canonical recipient_id from recipient_embeddings; limit two detects ambiguous duplicate identifiers.
claims.caveat: Stored profile evidence does not confirm current availability, acceptance or reservations. This tool is separate from the broker vector retrieval step.

claims.verified_fact: get_tract_equity selects one exact Washington tract from a4i_food.tract_demographics, returning poverty/no-vehicle and related fields. Its need_score is the mean of valid poverty and no-vehicle rates.
claims.caveat: Aggregate neighborhood indicators do not establish service catchments, live demand or individual circumstances.

claims.verified_fact: lookup_shelf_life is an HTTP tool on 127.0.0.1:8080/api/foodkeeper; the container includes data/foodkeeper.json. The context module pins its SHA256.
claims.caveat: Do not draw this as a BigQuery shelf-life table or a real-time USDA API call.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Storage · full-lot capacity · timing · service days · acceptance
claims.verified_fact: Pure deterministic checks gate candidate feasibility before ranking. Explicit rejection reasons produce rejected; missing critical facts produce needs_confirmation; only eligible rows compete for winner.
claims.caveat: These are profile-based coordination checks; recipient confirmation remains required.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Cold storage must match the offer
claims.verified_fact: Chilled offers reject none/dry/ambient storage. Missing or unrecognized storage remains unresolved. Refrigerated vehicle alone does not establish receiving-site storage; frozen offers require confirmed freezer support.
claims.caveat: Avoid the phrase cold-chain physics or a claim of food-safety certification.

claims.verified_fact: Candidate max_pallets must be known and at least the explicit offered pallet quantity.
claims.caveat: Split-load optimization is not implemented; no inferred crate-to-pallet conversion.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Fixed deadline · at least 15 minutes of coordination margin
claims.verified_fact: Default buffer is 0.25 hours. margin = remaining - pickup; rejected when remaining <= 0, margin <= 0, or margin < buffer. Exactly 0.25 hours passes the default boundary.
claims.caveat: The buffer is a coordination policy, not a food-safety guarantee; profile pickup estimate is not verified travel time.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Recheck the deadline after model work
claims.verified_fact: Original deadline persists; retrieval and synthesis consume the same window. Ranking is recomputed immediately before return. A changed winner causes a labeled deterministic draft.
claims.caveat: A variable named dispatch_clock_recheck does not mean the app actually dispatches a pickup.

claims.verified_fact: Among eligible candidates semantic=max(0,1-cosine distance); neighborhood=0.5*poverty+0.5*no_vehicle; logistics=0.5+0.3 if refrigerated_transport +0.2 if loading_dock. Composite weights are 0.40,0.35,0.25; sort descending composite, then distance and recipient_id.
claims.caveat: Missing neighborhood inputs contribute no score but remain disclosed; weights do not prove fairness, charity quality or delivered impact. There is no current 7.1% baseline multiplier.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Up to two eligible backup proposals
claims.verified_fact: Ranking returns winner and viable[1:3]. UI displays fewer than two backups honestly when unavailable.
claims.caveat: Automated decline-state fallback remains future work; no automatic rerouting or outreach.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Grounded facts + bounded Gemini handoff choices
claims.verified_fact: Gemini chooses tone, confirmation_focus and evidence_order. Deterministic renderer supplies factual recipient, quantity and deadline sections from the final checked result; model prose is not the factual source.
claims.caveat: Outputs are draft SMS/email and match brief, not sent messages.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Proposal · no viable match · blocked · labeled draft
claims.verified_fact: The broker distinguishes no retrieval/ranking (blocked), no eligible winner (no_viable_match), successful Gemini plan (success), and valid retrieval/gates but synthesis failure or winner change (draft).
claims.caveat: A deterministic draft must not be mislabeled successful model synthesis.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Human confirms acceptance, capacity and pickup
claims.verified_fact: Recipient acceptance, storage, capacity, pickup ETA, receiving hours and transport remain confirmation questions. App prepares handoff text and does not send, reserve, dispatch or establish delivery.
claims.caveat: No actual pickup is secured by a proposal or by copying a message.

claims.verified_fact: Frontend is HTML/CSS/JavaScript and Tailwind with Leaflet/OpenStreetMap. City layer reads bounded BigQuery rows through the BigQuery SDK, with tract and recipient geography bounds.
claims.caveat: Do not draw all map-data reads as MCP tool calls. Map coordinates may be approximate ZIP centroids.

claims.verified_fact: The UI constructs an external google.com/maps/dir URL from donor/winner coordinates. The in-app connector is illustrative; no road geometry or travel time is claimed.
claims.caveat: No integrated Routes API, embedded Google Maps basemap, or verified driving-time claim.

claims.verified_fact: Repository documentation reports 119 Seattle-area recipient profiles: 110 with generated operational details and nine planted teaching cases. IRS-derived identities underpin the base corpus.
claims.caveat: Counts are documented release evidence, not a fresh live query in this audit; generated operations are unverified and planted organizations may be invented.

claims.verified_fact: Repository documentation reports 389 Census ACS tract points. Current tract snapshot does not retain observation year.
claims.caveat: Not live household demand, verified service areas or individual attributes.

claims.verified_fact: Repository documents 661 pinned USDA FoodKeeper product references, retaining product options and unresolved applicability.
claims.caveat: No remaining freshness, commercial cold-chain safety clearance or change to donor deadline.

claims.verified_fact: Datasets inform the agent through retrieval; the project did not train or fine-tune a model.

README states the historical e1fbe03 ten-offer replay had two proposals and eight no-matches, predating later acceptance guards. Proposed-recipient neighborhood means were below the equal-tract baseline.
claims.caveat: Do not claim measured equity uplift or use the historical replay as a current acceptance-guard evaluation.

claims.verified_fact: Separate optional Gemini 3.8 Live lane uses the Google GenAI SDK in the Cloud Run API process to connect to external Vertex Live inference. Browser audio uses same-origin /api/live/intake WebSocket, Web Audio API/AudioWorklet. Default Vertex location us-central1; enabled only by FOOD_LIVE_ENABLED.
claims.caveat: Keep separate from Gemini 2.5 Flash broker and Cloud Run us-east1. Presence in source is not proof this feature is enabled in production.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Voice proposes a draft; coordinator applies and runs
claims.verified_fact: Live tools are draft_offer, read_current_match, read_recipient_evidence and show_alternatives. Draft changes only a proposal; three reads inspect bounded browser presentation state. Review/apply and explicit matching remain separate human actions.
claims.caveat: Voice read_recipient_evidence is a browser-state read, distinct from MCP get_recipient_evidence that retrieves the exact database row. Voice cannot match, fetch, rerank, send, reserve, approve, dispatch or pay.

claims.slide_safe_wording: Reservations and decline automation are future work
claims.verified_fact: Firestore reservations, decline-state automation, A2A negotiation, incentives, verified delivery accounting and production routing are explicitly future work.
claims.caveat: Omit from implemented architecture or clearly isolate as future work; do not connect as running services.
